summary: Tested the 10 Cloud Agent labs in Module 1, end to end through the backend and the UI. Backend: new pytest file, 15/15 pass. It covers hub order and locks, 403 on paid labs, every task check for Labs 1-10 including the negative paths (key missing fields, msiexec without /qn), reset restoring the preset state, and XP awarded only once. UI as student: the hub scan animation works (host grid, scan bar, CVE feed with real CVE IDs about every 1.1s, severity counters going up, label, progress %). Module 1 lists Lab 1..10, then the quiz and the CTF, and only Lab 1 is unlocked. Lab 1 completes 5/5 with the Finance Servers key showing in the table. With a temporary vmlab grant, Labs 2, 3 (existing), 4, 5, 6, 7 (prompt dialog), 8, 9 and 10 all reached vm-lab-complete through the real UI. Lab 5 reset restores the installed, running agent. Quiz and CTF pages load. Admin Manage lists all 12 items. Re-completing all labs gave no extra XP. No page errors. Only minor realism and copy issues found.

minor.issue: Every on-demand scan writes the log line 'On-demand VM scan requested', even for Type=PC and Type=Inventory. In Lab 9 t4 the learner runs Get-Content -Tail 5 and sees three 'VM scan' lines, which undercuts the lesson. Store the scan types in a list (e.g. st['scans']=['VM','PC','Inventory']) and print the matching type.
There is no event to turn self-protection off. Unticking the box and saving leaves shell.selfprot true. This is only a problem in free practice, since reset clears it.
ItemIn has no 'preset' field, so admin-created labs can't start with a pre-installed agent. Also, bumping SEED_VERSION overwrites any admin edits to the seeded labs.

ui_bugs.issue: The text 'Lab complete. Your agent is deployed and validated.' is hardcoded for every lab. It is wrong for Lab 1 (only a key was created), Lab 7 and Lab 10 (the agent was just uninstalled). Use a per-lab completion message or a generic one.
The 'Lab complete! +100 XP' toast shows every time a lab is completed, even after a reset when no XP is awarded (vm_awards). The API should return awarded:true/false and the toast should follow it.

After the terminal uninstall, WIN-LAB-01 leaves the agents table, but the open drawer still shows it as Active with working Deactivate/Uninstall buttons. Close the drawer, or show 'Uninstalled', once state.installed is false.

issues: Severity counts are listed 1→5 (Info first). VMDR tools usually list Critical (5) first, as the hub counters do.

action_items: Lab 9: make the on-demand scan log lines reflect the scan type (VM/PC/Inventory)
Completion banner: per-lab text instead of 'agent is deployed and validated'
Show the '+100 XP' toast only when XP was actually awarded
Lab 10: close or update the agent drawer after the host uninstall
Optional: event to disable self-protection; preset support in the admin editor
critical_code_review_comments: vm_shell.log_lines: scans is only a counter, so the scan type is lost.
routes_vmlab.finish: award result isn't exposed in the response, so the frontend can't tell a repeat completion from a first one.
routes_vmlab.event: modules on/off is stored for any host value. That's fine for now, but it isn't keyed per host.

/app/backend/tests/test_vmlab.py (old) assumes vm-lab-agent-win-cli is the free lab. It is now Lab 3 and paid, so TestHub.test_student_hub will fail. Update it or rely on the new test_vm_cloud_agent_labs.py.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (minor copy/realism issues only)

seed_data_creation: No records kept. Temporarily granted the student vmlab access, then revoked it. Reset every lab I touched for the student (0 vm_progress docs left). Reverted student XP to 1182 by deleting my 9 activity rows and 9 vm_awards (Labs 2-10). The pre-existing Lab 1 award was left in place. Admin data was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_vm_cloud_agent_labs.py -n0 (serial). It grants the student vmlab access through PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/access, then resets the labs and revokes the grant in fixture teardown. The first run awards 100 XP per lab without an existing vm_awards row, so revert db.activity, db.vm_awards and users.xp afterwards. Student id b9cafa42b8ca already had a vm_awards row for vm-lab-ca-01-deploy before my run. Admin login redirects to /admin, not /app.
